title: THE SILENCE
message: What disappears can leave room for something else.
meaning:
The Silence is not emptiness. It is the moment when an old structure stops providing an answer.

Something familiar is dissolving, but the absence it leaves behind is not necessarily a loss. At the far edge of what has vanished, another structure may already be beginning to form.

The card asks whether you are trying to restore what disappeared — or allowing the empty space to become something new.
imageAlt: A dissolving gothic structure fading into a dark empty space
